english.value: Archipelago of San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina

queries.kazakh_statements: SELECT ?item ?code ?name ?english ?rank ?ended WHERE { ?item p:P300 ?statement; rdfs:label ?name. FILTER(LANG(?name)="kk") ?statement ps:P300 ?code; wikibase:rank ?rank. OPTIONAL { ?statement pq:P582 ?ended. } OPTIONAL { ?item rdfs:label ?english. FILTER(LANG(?english)="en") } }
queries.morocco_statements: SELECT ?item ?code ?name ?rank ?ended WHERE { VALUES ?code { "MA-01" "MA-02" "MA-03" "MA-04" "MA-05" "MA-06" "MA-07" "MA-08" "MA-09" "MA-10" "MA-11" "MA-12" } ?item p:P300 ?statement; rdfs:label ?name. ?statement ps:P300 ?code; wikibase:rank ?rank. OPTIONAL { ?statement pq:P582 ?ended. } FILTER(LANG(?name) IN ("en","ru","kk")) }
